description.value: Modus is a Vancouver-based specialty coffee micro-roaster operating an intimate cafe at 112 West Broadway, known for a hyper-seasonal menu of single-origin light roasts built around close producer relationships. The Broadway shop doubles as a retail space for beans, brewing gear, and apparel, and is available for private events seating up to 30 people. Coffee education is offered through The Coffee Division, the workshop arm of the business, running public tastings and private corporate sessions.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 17m; stands (6 spaces) at 36m; stands (2 spaces) at 39m; stands (6 spaces) at 41m. Total: 16 spaces.
